summary: A GitHub repository's poller writes each item's compact state (vcs.item.state) on change and each derived event as one keyed github.event claim, and, per repository, stops writing resource.observed snapshots of its pull requests and issues once its plugin mirror is filled and every member depending on the repository's full item facts advertises the GitHub plugin. Pinned and discovered compact states read as observations; relayed plugin reads become typed.

replay.detail: No claim is rewritten or replayed. Snapshots older builds wrote stay and are read as before; compact states lay over them.

schema.detail: No new claim kind, subject family, table or storage version: vcs.item.state and github.event were registered by the previous step and are now written. The retention entry for vcs.item.state keeps no checkpoint rule, so the checkpoint rules digest is unchanged. features.github_plugin is 2 in daemon.started and /v1/health.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or rules digest changes. No fleet barrier: compact mode is decided per repository on each look from what its dependent members advertise.

compatibility.detail: Contract changes C6 (write side), C7 and C8 from the db break-up plan. The poller writes vcs.item.state and github.event claims. In compact mode, which needs a filled mirror and every dependent member (the host of each seat watching the repository, each member that declared a subscription on its observers, each member running a mission run pinned to one of its items) to advertise features.github_plugin>=1, it writes no resource.observed snapshot of an item: on members that do not poll, /v1/client/resources facts of such an item are the compact field set over its last snapshot, and full facts (comments, reviews, mentions, the per-check list) come from /v1/plugins/github/*. Mission discovery pins the compact state; gates on a pinned compact state read compact fields, and a path outside them is pending. An older member never sees snapshots stop for a repository it depends on, since it advertises no plugin; a 3a member reads compact states over snapshots already. New, additive: peer client read operation GithubPluginRead (capability github-plugin version 2, the poller builds the path); members still grant version 1 and send the path read to a version 1 poller. Tested beside the previous published release.

manual.detail: No operator action. To see whether a repository is in compact mode, compare its items' newest claims: vcs.item.state without a newer resource.observed.

recovery.detail: Rolling back to the previous release is supported: it writes snapshots again and reads compact states over them; mission runs pinned to a compact state while this build ran stay readable there. Rolling back below the release that introduced the plugin store keeps compact-mode items at their last snapshot until their next change is observed, and any run pinned to a compact state reads it as an unknown kind; this build enters compact mode only for repositories whose dependents all run the plugin store, so such a rollback should first be done on the dependents' members.
